title: Hydro Dynamics — Where It All Began
desc: Our first year in FIRST, learning teamwork, problem-solving, and creative design. Built a water-focused project and discovered the foundations of engineering collaboration.

title: Into Orbit — Launching to New Heights
desc: A breakout season where our robot and project reached new levels. Explored space challenges and earned top recognition while strengthening our passion for STEM.

title: Skystone — Our Rookie Journey
desc: First full robot build as an FTC team — learning CAD, machining, programming, and competition fundamentals. Laid the groundwork for all future seasons.

title: Ultimate Goal — Growing Through Challenge
desc: Focused on improving design and programming despite a difficult year. Strengthened our engineering workflow and learned how to adapt as a developing team.

title: Freight Frenzy — Leveling Up
desc: Enhanced robot reliability, strategy, and coding while expanding outreach. Achieved strong competitive results through disciplined engineering and teamwork.

title: POWERPLAY — A Breakout Season
desc: Welcomed new members, refined leadership, and earned our first Inspire Award. Captained the winning state alliance and qualified for the World Championship.

title: CENTERSTAGE — Expanding Our Impact
desc: Improved design and fabrication processes while growing outreach. Showcased robotics and CNC technology to thousands across Wisconsin.

title: Into the Deep — Engineering Forward
desc: Continued refining robot systems, CAD workflows, and machining skills. Expanded community impact through demos, events, and STEM partnerships.

title: DECODE — Building the Future
desc: Our current season — pushing new design ideas, improving fabrication, and deepening our outreach mission to inspire the next generation.
